meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 FlowIO 库读取和解析 FCS 流式细胞术标准文件（2.0、3.0、3.1），提取事件数据为 NumPy 数组，查看元数据和通道信息，也可创建新的 FCS 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取、检查或转换 FCS 文件，例如提取事件为数组、导出为表格、创建 FCS 文件，或处理多数据集文件时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 FCS 文件，告诉我版本、事件数和通道名。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并显示基本统计。

say.text: 把这个 FCS 文件的事件数据导出成 CSV。
say.note: Claude 将转换并保存 CSV 文件。

say.text: 用这两列数据生成一个新的 FCS 3.1 文件。
say.note: Claude 会调用创建功能写入文件。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use the FlowIO Python library to read and parse FCS files (v2.0–3.1), extract events as NumPy arrays, inspect metadata and channels, and create new FCS files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read, inspect, or convert FCS files—such as extracting events to arrays, exporting tables, creating FCS files, or handling multi-dataset files.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and tell me the version, event count, and channel names.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the file and show basic stats.

say_en.text: Export the event data from this FCS file to CSV.
say_en.note: Claude will convert and save the CSV file.

say_en.text: Create a new FCS 3.1 file from these two columns of data.
say_en.note: Claude will use the create function to write the file.
